capex: In addition to supporting our internal requirements, Swastik manufactures tungsten metal powders, tungsten carbide powders, ready-to-press powders and tungsten carbide components with an annual combined capacity of 120 T

focus: Over the years, we have deliberately focused on specialized, value-added materials rather than commodity products.
